title: Ethiopian-Style Garlicky Vegan Custard Bake
description: A rich and creamy vegan custard bake infused with the flavors of Ethiopia, perfect for a comforting dessert. This recipe is free from animal products and is easy to make.
instructions: In a blender, combine the non-dairy milk, custard, vanilla, and nutmeg. Blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, coconut oil, and maple syrup.
Add the flour mixture to the blender and blend until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish and bake for 35-40 minutes or until set.
While the custard bake is baking, prepare the garlicky topping by mincing the garlic cloves.
After the custard bake has baked for 25 minutes, remove it from the oven and sprinkle the garlic on top.
Return the custard bake to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the garlic is golden brown.
Remove the custard bake from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Slice the custard bake into squares and serve warm or at room temperature.
